collocations.en: set a date for the meeting
make a decision on this matter

messages.en: Everyone's made their suggestions. Let's decide tonight, okay?
Sure, I want to check the prices first. Then we can choose.
I heard on the radio earlier that the road near our office will be closed this afternoon.
Oh, no wonder so many people want to leave early. I'll just take the train today.

senses.en_definition: Something known only to one person or a small number of people and kept from others.
Hidden information or knowledge; an underlying method, principle, or mystery.
Kept from public knowledge; secret or confidential.

messages.en: I've got a new job offer, but let's keep it between us for now, okay? Don't tell anyone else yet.
Wow, congrats! Don't worry, I won't tell anyone. When do you start?
Probably next month. Let me confirm the date first.

senses.en_definition: A hereditary ruler or head of state; a king or monarch.
A royal title used by certain descendants of a sultan.
A person with great power or influence in a particular industry or sphere.
An animal or other being regarded as ruling over others of its kind.
The most important piece in chess, which must be protected from checkmate.
A playing card bearing the image of a king and marked K.

messages.en: Tomorrow's your wedding day—you'll be king for a day! Bet you can't wait, right?
I can't wait, but I'm nervous too. I'm worried I'll forget what to say during the marriage ceremony.
You've practised, haven't you? Get an early night tonight.
